text: My daily routine is built on consistency, which helps me stay productive and calm. I wake up at six thirty every morning, and my first habit is drinking a large glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I review my to-do list for the day. My work schedule starts at nine, and I usually focus on my most challenging tasks in the morning when I have the most energy. Around noon, I take a short break for lunch and a brisk fifteen-minute walk. In the afternoon, I attend meetings and answer emails. After work, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either jogging or doing yoga. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, and relaxing with my family. Finally, I prepare my clothes and notes for the next day before going to bed at ten thirty. This predictable rhythm keeps me balanced and reduces stress.
